description: This file provides processor-specific macros, register definitions, and inline functions for accessing and manipulating Nios II control registers and features within the Zephyr RTOS environment.

methods.name: _nios2_read_et
methods.description: Reads the Exception Temporary register (et) using inline assembly.

methods.name: _nios2_write_et
methods.description: Writes to the et register using inline assembly.

methods.name: _nios2_read_sp
methods.description: Reads the stack pointer register (sp) using inline assembly.

methods.name: z_nios2_break
methods.description: Triggers a breakpoint instruction for debugging.

methods.name: _nios2_report_stack_overflow
methods.description: Triggers a breakpoint to indicate stack overflow.
